title: 2014 年全国硕士研究生招生考试 英语（二）

sections.title: Section I　完形填空
sections.dir: Read the following text. Choose the best word(s) for each numbered blank and mark A, B, C or D on the ANSWER SHEET. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线："瘦并不总是更好"——超重有时反有保护作用，肥胖本身却难界定。7 题 equals、12 题 qualify as 是纯搭配题。

paras.en: Thinner isn't always better. A number of studies have 1 that normal-weight people are in fact at higher risk of some diseases compared to those who are overweight. And there are health conditions for which being overweight is actually 2 . For example, heavier women are less likely to develop calcium deficiency than thin women. 3 , among the elderly, being somewhat overweight is often an 4 of good health.
paras.zh: 瘦并不总是更好。多项研究已经 1，与超重者相比，体重正常的人实际上患某些疾病的风险更高。而且有些健康状况下，超重其实是有 2 的。例如，体重较重的女性比瘦女性更不容易缺钙。3，在老年人当中，略微超重往往也是身体健康的 4。

paras.en: Of even greater 5 is the fact that obesity turns out to be very difficult to define. It is often defined 6 body mass index, or BMI. BMI 7 body mass divided by the square of height. An adult with a BMI of 18-25 is often considered to be normal weight. Between 25 and 30 is overweight. And over 30 is considered obese. Obesity, 8 , can be divided into moderately obese, severely obese, and very severely obese.
paras.zh: 更值得 5 的是，肥胖原来很难界定。人们通常 6 体重指数（BMI）来界定它。BMI 7 体重除以身高的平方。BMI 在 18 到 25 之间的成年人常被视为体重正常，25 到 30 之间为超重，超过 30 则被视为肥胖。肥胖 8 又可分为中度肥胖、重度肥胖和极重度肥胖。

paras.en: While such numerical standards seem 9 , they are not. Obesity is probably less a matter of weight than body fat. Some people with a high BMI are in fact extremely fit, 10 others with a low BMI may be in poor 11 . For example, many collegiate and professional football players 12 as obese, though their percentage body fat is low. Conversely, someone with a small frame may have high body fat but a 13 BMI.
paras.zh: 这些数字标准看似 9，其实并非如此。肥胖与其说是体重问题，不如说是体脂问题。有些 BMI 很高的人实际上非常健康，10 有些 BMI 很低的人身体状况却可能很 11。例如，许多大学队和职业橄榄球队的球员 12 肥胖之列，尽管他们的体脂率很低。反过来，个子小的人可能体脂很高，BMI 却 13。

paras.en: Today we have a(n) 14 to label obesity as a disgrace. The overweight are sometimes 15 in the media with their faces covered. Stereotypes 16 with obesity include laziness, lack of will power, and lower prospects for success. Teachers, employers, and health professionals have been shown to harbor biases against the obese. 17 very young children tend to look down on the overweight, and teasing about body build has long been a problem in schools.
paras.zh: 如今我们有一种 14，把肥胖看作一件丢脸的事。超重者有时在媒体上被 15，面部还被打上马赛克。与肥胖 16 的刻板印象包括懒惰、缺乏意志力以及成功前景较差。教师、雇主和健康专业人士都被证明对肥胖者怀有偏见。17 很小的孩子也往往看不起超重的人，而拿体型开玩笑长期以来一直是校园里的问题。

paras.en: Negative attitudes toward obesity, 18 in health concerns, have stimulated a number of anti-obesity 19 . My own hospital system has banned sugary drinks from its facilities. Many employers have instituted weight loss and fitness initiatives. Michelle Obama has launched a high-visibility campaign 20 childhood obesity, even claiming that it represents our greatest national security threat.
paras.zh: 对肥胖的负面态度 18 于健康方面的担忧，已经催生了不少反肥胖 19。我所在的医院系统已禁止院内销售含糖饮料。许多雇主也推出了减肥与健身计划。米歇尔·奥巴马发起了一场高曝光度的 20 儿童肥胖的运动，甚至声称儿童肥胖是我们最大的国家安全威胁。

items.exp: 定位首段②句 A number of studies have ___ that normal-weight people are in fact at higher risk：that 从句摆出的是研究得出的结论，conclude that 正合。denied（否认）、doubted（怀疑）会否掉后面的结论，ensured（确保）的主语不能是 studies。
定位③句 there are health conditions for which being overweight is actually ___：紧接的钙缺乏例子说明超重反而"有保护作用"，故 protective。dangerous、troublesome 与例子方向相反，sufficient（充足的）不用于描述某种体重状态。
定位④⑤句：前一句举 heavier women 的例子，后一句举 among the elderly 的例子，两个例证同向并列，用 Likewise（同样地）。Instead 表替代、However 表转折、Therefore 表因果，都会把并列读成对立或推论。
定位同句 being somewhat overweight is often an ___ of good health：超重在这里被当作"健康的一个标志"，indicator 正确。objective（目标）、origin（起源）、example（例子）都无法表达"体征反映健康状况"这层关系。
定位第二段首句 Of even greater ___ is the fact that obesity turns out to be very difficult to define：承上段"超重有益"，转入"肥胖难界定"这一更令人担忧的问题，Of even greater concern 是固定说法。impact、relevance、assistance 都读不出"令人担忧"的态度。
定位②句 It is often defined ___ body mass index, or BMI：下文就在解释 BMI 如何计算，说明肥胖是"依据"体重指数来界定的，in terms of（依据、就……而言）正确。in case of（万一）、in favor of（支持）、in respects of 均不含"依据"义。
定位③句 BMI ___ body mass divided by the square of height：后面给的是计算公式，前后数值相等，equals（等于）正确。measures 只表"测量"，接不上"除以身高平方"；determines、modifies 都曲解了等式关系。
定位第二段末句 Obesity, ___, can be divided into moderately obese, severely obese, and very severely obese：上句刚把"超过 30"定为肥胖，本句进一步把肥胖再分三级，in turn 表递进、进一步。in essence、in contrast、in part 都不承接这层递进。
定位第三段首句 While such numerical standards seem ___, they are not：While 表让步，后文 they are not 说明"看着简单，其实不然"，straightforward（简单明了）正确。complicated 与 they are not 语义重复，conservative、variable 与"数值标准"不搭。
定位③句 Some people with a high BMI are in fact extremely fit, ___ others with a low BMI may be in poor shape：前后两类人形成对照，while 表对比。so 表结果、since 表原因、unless 表条件，都会把这组对比读成因果或条件。
定位同句 others with a low BMI may be in poor ___：与 extremely fit 相对，说的是"身体状况差"，in poor shape 为固定搭配。spirit、balance、taste 都不能与 in poor 组成"健康不佳"之意。
定位④句 many collegiate and professional football players ___ as obese：球员按 BMI 标准"可算作"肥胖，qualify as 意为"取得……资格、可被认定为"。start as（以……起步）、retire（退役）、stay as 都与"按标准归类"无关。
定位末句 someone with a small frame may have high body fat but a ___ BMI：Conversely 引出与"高 BMI 却健康"相反的情形——体脂高而 BMI 正常，故 normal。strange、changeable 与"落在正常区间"不符，constant 强调不变，也不合文意。
定位第四段首句 Today we have a(n) ___ to label obesity as a disgrace：下文列媒体遮挡面部、刻板印象、教师雇主偏见，说明这是一种普遍"倾向"，tendency 正确。option（选择权）、reason（理由）、opportunity（机会）都概括不了这种社会心态。
定位②句 The overweight are sometimes ___ in the media with their faces covered：本句讲媒体如何"呈现"肥胖者，pictured（被拍摄、被描绘）与 with their faces covered 呼应。employed（受雇）、imitated（被模仿）、monitored（被监控）都与"出镜"无关。
定位③句 Stereotypes ___ with obesity include laziness, lack of will power...：讲的是"与肥胖联系在一起的"刻板印象，be associated with 是固定搭配。compared with（与……相比）、combined with（与……结合）、settled with 都不能表示"相关联"。
定位⑤句 ___ very young children tend to look down on the overweight：上文是教师、雇主、专业人员怀有偏见，本句进一步说连小孩子也如此，Even 表递进强调。Still、Yet 表转折，Only 会读成"只有小孩"，都不合递进逻辑。
定位末段首句 Negative attitudes toward obesity, ___ in health concerns：这些负面态度"以健康方面的担忧为依据"，be grounded in 意为"以……为基础"。despised、corrected、ignored 填入后都无法与 in health concerns 搭配成句。
定位同句 have stimulated a number of anti-obesity ___：下文医院禁售含糖饮料、雇主推减肥计划、奥巴马发起运动，都是具体"政策、举措"，故 policies。discussions、businesses、studies 概括不了这些行动。
定位末句 launched a high-visibility campaign ___ childhood obesity：campaign against 意为"反对……的运动"，与"儿童肥胖是最大安全威胁"的立场一致。campaign for 会读成"支持肥胖"，with、without 也无法与 campaign 搭配出"抗击"之意。

sections.title: Text 1　钱怎样花才最值
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：《快乐金钱》主张买体验胜过买物品。21 题的 rich meal 是陷阱，23 题别被 marketing trick 带走。

paras.en: What would you do with $590m? This is now a question for Gloria MacKenzie, an 84-year-old widow who recently emerged from her small, tin-roofed house in Florida to collect the biggest undivided lottery jackpot in history. If she hopes her new-found fortune will yield lasting feelings of fulfilment, she could do worse than read Happy Money by Elizabeth Dunn and Michael Norton.
paras.zh: 你会怎么花 5.9 亿美元？这如今是格洛丽亚·麦肯齐要面对的问题。这位 84 岁的寡妇最近走出她在佛罗里达那栋铁皮屋顶的小房子，来领取史上金额最大的独中彩票头奖。如果她希望这笔新得的财富能带来持久的满足感，那她不妨去读一读伊丽莎白·邓恩和迈克尔·诺顿合写的《快乐金钱》。

paras.en: These two academics use an array of behavioral research to show that the most rewarding ways to spend money can be counterintuitive. Fantasies of great wealth often involve visions of fancy cars and extravagant homes. Yet satisfaction with these material purchases wears off fairly quickly. What was once exciting and new becomes old-hat; regret creeps in. It is far better to spend money on experiences, say Ms Dunn and Mr Norton, like interesting trips, unique meals or even going to the cinema. These purchases often become more valuable with time - as stories or memories - particularly if they involve feeling more connected to others.
paras.zh: 这两位学者运用一系列行为学研究说明，最让人有收获的花钱方式往往与直觉相反。对巨额财富的幻想，常常伴随着豪车与豪宅的图景。然而，这类物质消费带来的满足感消退得相当快。曾经令人兴奋、新鲜的东西变得老套，悔意随之而来。邓恩女士和诺顿先生说，把钱花在"体验"上要好得多，比如有趣的旅行、独特的餐食，甚至去看一场电影。这些消费往往会随时间推移——作为故事或记忆——变得更有价值，尤其是当它们让你与他人感觉更亲近时。

paras.en: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck." It seems most people would be better off if they could shorten their commutes to work, spend more time with friends and family and less of it watching television (something the average American spends a whopping two months a year doing, and is hardly jollier for it). Buying gifts or giving to charity is often more pleasurable than purchasing things for oneself, and luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly. This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib — a marketing trick that has turned the pork sandwich into an object of obsession.
paras.zh: 这本薄薄的书里塞满了小窍门，帮打工族和彩票中奖者把"每一块钱换来的快乐"最大化。看来，多数人若能缩短通勤、多花时间陪亲友、少看点电视（普通美国人一年看电视的时间多达两个月，却并没因此更快乐），日子会过得更好。买礼物送人或捐给慈善机构，往往比自己买东西更令人愉快；而奢侈品只有在少量享用时才最令人愉悦。这显然就是麦当劳限制其热门产品 McRib 供应量的原因——这一营销手法把这款猪肉三明治变成了众人痴迷的对象。

paras.en: Readers of Happy Money are clearly a privileged lot, anxious about fulfilment, not hunger. Money may not quite buy happiness, but people in wealthier countries are generally happier than those in poor ones. Yet the link between feeling good and spending money on others can be seen among rich and poor people around the world, and scarcity enhances the pleasure of most things for most people. Not everyone will agree with the authors' policy ideas, which range from mandating more holiday time to reducing tax incentives for American homebuyers. But most people will come away from this book believing it was money well spent.
paras.zh: 《快乐金钱》的读者显然是境遇优渥的一群人，他们操心的是自我实现，而不是饥饿。金钱或许买不来幸福，但富裕国家的人总体上比贫穷国家的人更幸福。不过，"感觉良好"与"为他人花钱"之间的联系，在世界各地的富人和穷人身上都能看到；而对大多数人来说，稀缺会提升大多数事物的乐趣。并非人人都会认同两位作者的政策主张——从强制增加休假时间到削减美国购房者的税收优惠，不一而足。但多数人读完这本书都会觉得，这钱花得值。

items.stem: According to Dunn and Norton, which of the following is the most rewarding purchase?
items.exp: 定位第二段⑤句 It is far better to spend money on experiences... like interesting trips：作者把"体验"列为最值的花钱方式，special tour 即 interesting trips，故 B。D 是最强干扰——unique meals 的落点在"独特体验"，rich 却把意思移到"丰盛、昂贵"，落回被否定的物质消费；A、C 即文中的 fancy cars 与 extravagant homes。

items.stem: The author's attitude toward Americans' watching TV is
items.exp: 定位第三段：美国人一年看电视多达两个月，作者用 whopping（多得惊人）并补一句 and is hardly jollier for it（也没因此更快乐），还把它列在"日子会过得更好"该减少的事项里，态度是批评，故 A。supportive、sympathetic 与这句反讽相反；ambiguous 不成立，作者取舍很清楚。

items.stem: McRib is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to show that
items.exp: 定位第三段末两句：luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly，紧接着说这正是麦当劳限量供应 McRib 的原因，例子服务于"稀缺提升愉悦"，故 D。C 的 marketing tricks 是原文措辞，但它是作者用来解释"限量为何奏效"的定语，落点在稀缺本身，属答非所问的强干扰。

items.stem: According to the last paragraph, Happy Money
opts: has left much room for readers' criticism
may prove to be a worthwhile purchase
has predicted a wider income gap in the US
may give its readers a sense of achievement
items.exp: 定位末段末句 most people will come away from this book believing it was money well spent：读者读完觉得"这钱花得值"，即这本书本身是一笔划算的购买，故 B。A 把"有些人不认同作者的政策主张"夸大成"留给读者批评空间"；C 的 income gap、D 的 sense of achievement 文中均无。

items.stem: This text mainly discusses how to
opts: balance feeling good and spending money
spend large sums of money won in lotteries
obtain lasting satisfaction from money spent
become more reasonable in spending on luxuries
items.exp: 全文由"彩票巨奖怎么花"引出，主体是《快乐金钱》的主张——买体验、买与他人的联结、奢侈品要少而精，落点都是"如何从花出去的钱里得到持久满足"，故 C。A 把 feeling good 与 spending 并列，文中前者是后者的结果；B 只是首段的引子；D 仅覆盖奢侈品一句。

sections.title: Text 2　我们为何高估自己
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：人天生自我美化，认不出照片里的自己。27 题 automatic 是坑，落点在 intuitively。

paras.en: An article in Scientific American has pointed out that empirical research says that, actually, you think you're more beautiful than you are. We have a deep-seated need to feel good about ourselves and we naturally employ a number of self-enhancing strategies to achieve this. Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others - all obviously statistical impossibilities.
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》上的一篇文章指出，实证研究表明：实际上，你觉得自己比真实的自己更漂亮。我们有一种根深蒂固的需要，即对自己感觉良好，于是我们自然而然地运用各种自我提升策略来达到这一目的。社会心理学家对他们所称的"高于平均水平效应"或"虚幻的优越感"积累了大量研究，并表明：例如，我们中有 70% 的人认为自己的领导力高于平均水平，93% 的人认为自己的驾驶技术高于平均水平，85% 的人认为自己与人相处的能力高于平均水平——这些显然在统计上都不可能。

paras.en: We rose-tint our memories and put ourselves into self-affirming situations. We become defensive when criticised, and apply negative stereotypes to others to boost our own esteem. We stalk around thinking we're hot stuff.
paras.zh: 我们给自己的记忆染上玫瑰色，把自己置于自我肯定的情境中。受到批评时，我们变得防御；我们给别人贴上负面刻板印象的标签，以抬高自己的自尊。我们四处走动，觉得自己很了不起。

paras.en: Psychologist and behavioural scientist Nicholas Epley oversaw a key study into self-enhancement and attractiveness. Rather than have people simply rate their beauty compared with others, he asked them to identify an original photograph of themselves from a lineup including versions that had been altered to appear more and less attractive. Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation". If the subjects quickly chose a falsely flattering image — which most did — they genuinely believed it was really how they looked.
paras.zh: 心理学家、行为科学家尼古拉斯·埃普利主持了一项关于自我提升与吸引力的重要研究。他没有让人简单地评价自己比别人美多少，而是请他们从一组照片中认领自己未经修改的原照，这些照片中既有被修得更美的版本，也有被修得更丑的版本。该研究指出，视觉识别是"一种自动的心理过程，发生得迅速而凭直觉，几乎或完全没有明显的意识斟酌"。如果受试者迅速挑出一张美化过的不实照片——多数人确实如此——他们是真心相信那就是自己的样子。

paras.en: Epley found no significant gender difference in responses. Nor was there any evidence that those who self-enhanced the most (that is, the participants who thought the most positively doctored pictures were real) were doing so to make up for profound insecurities. In fact, those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem. "I don't think the findings that we have are any evidence of personal delusion," says Epley. "It's a reflection simply of people generally thinking well of themselves." If you are depressed, you won't be self-enhancing.
paras.zh: 埃普利发现，受试者的反应没有显著的性别差异。也没有任何证据表明，那些自我提升程度最高的人（即认为修得最好看的照片才是真人的受试者）这样做是为了弥补内心深处的缺乏安全感。事实上，那些认为吸引力刻度更靠上的照片才是真人的人，与那些表现出其他高自尊标志的人正好对应。埃普利说："我不认为我们的发现能证明个人妄想。""它只反映了人们总体上对自己评价不错。"如果你情绪抑郁，你就不会自我提升。

paras.en: Knowing the results of Epley's study, it makes sense that many people hate photographs of themselves viscerally — on one level, they don't even recognise the person in the picture as themselves. Facebook, therefore, is a self-enhancer's paradise, where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles. It's not that people's profiles are dishonest, says Catalina Toma of Wisconsin-Madison University, "but they portray an idealised version of themselves."
paras.zh: 了解了埃普利的研究结果，许多人打心底里讨厌自己的照片也就说得通了——在某个层面上，他们根本不把照片里的人认作自己。因此，Facebook 是自我提升者的天堂：人们在那里只分享最好看的照片，只展示自己才智、风格、美貌、学识和生活方式中最精华的部分。威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的卡塔利娜·托马说，问题不在于人们的个人主页不诚实，"而在于它们描绘的是一个理想化的自己"。

items.stem: According to the first paragraph, social psychologists have found that
opts: illusory superiority is a baseless effect
our need for leadership is unnatural

sections.title: Text 3　人机之争还是人机同行
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：机器吃掉的是"照本宣科"的岗位，出路是人机同行。35 题标题必须覆盖"人机矛盾"这条主线。

paras.en: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries. And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle. Certain jobs have gone away for good, outmoded by machines. Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
paras.zh: 人机对立的概念至少和工业革命一样古老，但这一现象往往在经济下行和复苏乏力的时期感受最为强烈。然而，如果认为我们现在只是经历繁荣与萧条周期中痛苦的一面，那就错了。某些工作岗位已被机器淘汰，一去不复返。既然技术吞噬人类岗位的胃口如此之大，这一现象将继续以我们无法立即预见的方式重塑我们的经济。

paras.en: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened. This argument has attracted a lot of attention, via the success of the book Race Against the Machine, by Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee, who both hail from MIT's Center for Digital Business.
paras.zh: 当技术的价格与性能迅速改善时，那些曾被认为不受自动化影响的岗位突然受到威胁。这一论点因《与机器赛跑》一书的畅销而广受关注，该书作者埃里克·布林约尔松和安德鲁·麦卡菲都来自麻省理工学院数字商务中心。

paras.en: This is a powerful argument, and a scary one. And yet, John Hagel, author of The Power of Pull and other books, says Brynjolfsson and McAfee miss the reason why these jobs are so vulnerable to technology in the first place.
paras.zh: 这是一个有力的论点，也是一个可怕的论点。然而，《拉动力》等书的作者约翰·哈格尔说，布林约尔松和麦卡菲忽略了这些岗位为何从一开始就如此易受技术冲击的原因。

paras.en: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the U.S. that tend to be "tightly scripted" and "highly standardized" ones that leave no room for "individual initiative or creativity". In short, these are the types of jobs that machines can perform much better at than human beings. That is how we have put a giant target sign on the backs of American workers, Hagel says.
paras.zh: 哈格尔说，我们在美国把工作设计成"脚本严密""高度标准化"的类型，没有给"个人主动性或创造力"留下任何空间。简言之，这些正是机器能比人干得好得多的岗位。哈格尔说，我们就是这样在美国工人背上贴了一个巨大的靶标。

paras.en: It's time to reinvent the formula for how work is conducted, since we are still relying on a very 20th century notion of work, Hagel says. In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events". That is not something machines are good at. They are designed to perform very predictable activities.
paras.zh: 哈格尔说，是时候彻底改造工作的方式了，因为我们仍然依赖一种非常 20 世纪的工作观念。在我们这个迅速变化的经济中，我们比以往任何时候都更需要工作场所里有能够发挥主动性、运用想象力"应对突发事件"的人。这不是机器所擅长的。机器被设计来执行极易预测的活动。

paras.en: As Hagel notes, Brynjolfsson and McAfee indeed touched on this point in their book. We need to reframe race against the machine as race with the machine. In other words, we need to look at the ways in which machines can augment human labor rather than replace it. So then the problem is not really about technology, but rather, "how do we innovate our institutions and our work practices?"
paras.zh: 正如哈格尔所指出的，布林约尔松和麦卡菲在他们的书中确实提到了这一点。我们需要把"与机器赛跑"重新表述为"与机器同行"。换句话说，我们要关注的是机器能够增强而非取代人类劳动的那些方式。那么问题其实不在于技术，而在于"我们如何革新自己的制度和我们的工作方式"。

sections.title: Text 4　被低估的住房投资
sections.dir: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (40 points)
sections.note: 主线：住房对经济的贡献被忽视，症结在政治化与拨款到期。40 题问 2015 年之后，盯住 unlikely to be extended。

paras.en: When the government talks about infrastructure contributing to the economy the focus is usually on roads, railways, broadband and energy. Housing is seldom mentioned.
paras.zh: 当政府谈论基础设施对经济的贡献时，焦点通常落在公路、铁路、宽带和能源上。住房很少被提及。

paras.en: Why is that? To some extent the housing sector must shoulder the blame. We have not been good at communicating the real value that housing can contribute to economic growth. Then there is the scale of the typical housing project. It is hard to shove for attention among multibillion-pound infrastructure projects, so it is inevitable that the attention is focused elsewhere. But perhaps the most significant reason is that the issue has always been so politically charged.
paras.zh: 这是为什么？在某种程度上，住房行业自己必须承担责任。我们一直不善于讲清楚住房能为经济增长贡献的真正价值。其次是典型住房项目的规模问题。在动辄数十亿英镑的基础设施项目中，住房很难争得关注，注意力自然会集中在别处。但也许最重要的原因是，这个问题历来政治色彩太浓。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the affordable housing situation is desperate. Waiting lists increase all the time and we are simply not building enough new homes.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，可支付住房的处境已十分严峻。等待名单一直在变长，而我们新建的住房根本不够。

paras.en: The comprehensive spending review offers an opportunity for the government to help rectify this. It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.
paras.zh: 综合开支审查为政府纠正这一局面提供了机会。政府需要把历史偏见搁到一边，采取一些措施来解决我们迫切的住房需求。

paras.en: There are some indications that it is preparing to do just that. The communities minister, Don Foster, has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt. Evidence shows that 60,000 extra new homes could be built over the next five years if the cap were lifted, increasing GDP by 0.6%.
paras.zh: 有一些迹象表明，政府正准备这么做。社区事务大臣唐·福斯特暗示，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能会放宽目前对地方政府以住房存量债务为抵押的借款额度上限。有证据表明，如果取消这一上限，未来五年可以多建 6 万套新住房，使 GDP 增长 0.6%。

paras.en: Ministers should also look at creating greater certainty in the rental environment, which would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues.
paras.zh: 部长们还应考虑提高住房租赁环境的确定性，这将对注册供应方用收入为新开发项目提供资金的能力产生重大影响。

paras.en: But it is not just down to the government. While these measures would be welcome in the short term, we must face up to the fact that the existing £ 4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then. The Labour party has recently announced that it will retain a large part of the coalition's spending plans if it returns to power. The housing sector needs to accept that we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants. We need to adjust to this changing climate.
paras.zh: 但这并不只是政府的事。虽然这些措施短期内会受欢迎，我们必须正视这样一个事实：现有的 45 亿英镑新建可支付住房拨款计划将于 2015 年到期，届时不太可能获得延期。工党最近宣布，如果重新执政，将保留联合政府开支计划的很大一部分。住房行业需要接受：我们很可能再也回不到大规模公共拨款的时代了。我们必须适应这一变化的环境。

paras.en: While the government's commitment to long-term funding may have changed, the very pressing need for more affordable housing is real and is not going away.
paras.zh: 虽然政府对长期拨款的承诺可能已经改变，但对更多可支付住房的迫切需求是真实存在的，而且不会消失。

sections.title: Section II Part B　多项对应（作品与描述匹配）
sections.dir: Read the following text and match each of the numbered items in the left column to its corresponding information in the right column. There are two extra choices in the right column. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (10 points)
sections.note: 五件作品各占一段，描述里的动作词就是钥匙。F 借 Scottish artist 伪装成 45 题，落点其实是 epic walk。
subs: originates from a long walk that the artist took.
illustrates a kind of landscape-orientated light conceptual art.
reminds people of the English landscape painting tradition.
represents the elegance of the British land art.
depicts the ordinary side of the British land art.
embodies a romantic escape into the Scottish outdoors.
contains images from different parts of the same photograph.
sections.intro:
Emerging in the late Sixties and reaching a peak in the Seventies, Land Art was one of a range of new forms, including Body Art, Performance Art, Action Art and Installation Art, which pushed art beyond the traditional confines of the studio and gallery. Rather than portraying landscape, land artists used the physical substance of the land itself as their medium.

The British land art, typified by Richard Long's piece, was not only more domestically scaled, but a lot quirkier than its American counterpart. Indeed, while you might assume that an exhibition of Land Art would consist only of records of works rather than the works themselves, Long's photograph of his work is the work. Since his "action" is in the past, the photograph is its sole embodiment.

That might seem rather an obscure point, but it sets the tone for an exhibition that contains a lot of black-and-white photographs and relatively few natural objects.

Long is Britain's best-known Land Artist and his Stone Circle, a perfect ring of purplish rocks from Portishead beach laid out on the gallery floor, represents the elegant, rarefied side of the form. The Boyle Family, on the other hand, stand for its dirty, urban aspect. Comprising artists Mark Boyle and Joan Hills and their children, they recreated random sections of the British landscape on gallery walls. Their Olaf Street Study, a square of brick-strewn waste ground, is one of the few works here to embrace the commonplaceness that characterises most of our experience of the landscape most of the time.

Parks feature, particularly in the earlier works, such as John Hilliard's very funny Across the Park, in which a long-haired stroller is variously smiled at by a pretty girl and unwittingly assaulted in a sequence of images that turn out to be different parts of the same photograph.

Generally however British land artists preferred to get away from towns, gravitating towards landscapes that are traditionally considered beautiful such as the Lake District or the Wiltshire Downs. While it probably wasn't apparent at the time, much of this work is permeated by a spirit of romantic escapism that the likes of Wordsworth would have readily understood. Derek Jarman's yellow-tinted film Towards Avebury, a collection of long, mostly still shots of the Wiltshire landscape, evokes a tradition of English landscape painting stretching from Samuel Palmer to Paul Nash.

In the case of Hamish Fulton, you can't help feeling that the Scottish artist has simply found a way of making his love of walking pay. A typical work, such as Seven Days, consists of a single beautiful black-and-white photograph taken on an epic walk, with the mileage and number of days taken listed beneath. British Land Art as shown in this well selected, but relatively modestly scaled exhibition wasn't about imposing on the landscape, more a kind of landscape-orientated light conceptual art created passing through. It had its origins in the great outdoors, but the results were as gallery-bound as the paintings of Turner and Constable.

blocks.exp: 定位第四段②句：Long is Britain's best-known Land Artist and his Stone Circle ... represents the elegant, rarefied side of the form，elegant 与 D 的 elegance 逐词对应。E 的 the ordinary side 是同段 Boyle Family 的特征，正好相反，是本题最强干扰。

定位第四段⑤句：Their Olaf Street Study, a square of brick-strewn waste ground, is one of the few works here to embrace the commonplaceness——commonplaceness（寻常、平淡）即 E 的 the ordinary side。D 的 elegance 属于上一句的 Stone Circle，一雅一俗是本题的对照设计。

定位第五段：John Hilliard's very funny Across the Park ... in a sequence of images that turn out to be different parts of the same photograph，与 G 的 contains images from different parts of the same photograph 几乎原词复现，无需推断。

定位第六段末句：Derek Jarman's yellow-tinted film Towards Avebury ... evokes a tradition of English landscape painting stretching from Samuel Palmer to Paul Nash，evokes a tradition 即 C 的 reminds people of the English landscape painting tradition。B 的 light conceptual art 是对整场展览的总结，不属于这一件作品。
定位第七段②句：A typical work, such as Seven Days, consists of a single black-and-white photograph taken on an epic walk——作品源自一次长途徒步，故 A。F 用 Scottish artist 与 romantic escapism 设套，但那句说的是英国大地艺术的整体气质。

sections.title: Section III　翻译
sections.dir: Translate the following text into Chinese. Write your translation on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)
sections.note: 难点：make the best of 是"尽力做好"；grants himself permission 要译出"允许自己"的语气。

paras.en: Most people would define optimism as being endlessly happy, with a glass that's perpetually half full. But that's exactly the kind of false cheerfulness that positive psychologists wouldn't recommend. "Healthy optimism means being in touch with reality," says Tal Ben-Shahar, a Harvard professor. According to Ben-Shahar, realistic optimists are those who make the best of things that happen, but not those who believe everything happens for the best.
paras.zh: 多数人会把乐观定义为永远快乐，认为杯子始终是半满的。但这恰恰是积极心理学家不推荐的那种虚假的振作。"健康的乐观意味着不脱离现实，"哈佛大学教授塔尔·本-沙哈尔说。按照本-沙哈尔的看法，现实的乐观者是那些把所发生的事情尽力处理好的人，而不是那些相信一切都会朝最好方向发展的人。

paras.en: Ben-Shahar uses three optimistic exercises. When he feels down — say, after giving a bad lecture — he grants himself permission to be human. He reminds himself that not every lecture can be a Nobel winner; some will be less effective than others. Next is reconstruction. He analyzes the weak lecture, learning lessons for the future about what works and what doesn't. Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
paras.zh: 本-沙哈尔采用三种乐观练习。当他情绪低落时——比如讲完一堂糟糕的课之后——他会允许自己只是个凡人。他提醒自己，不是每一堂课都能得诺贝尔奖，有些课的效果就是不如别的课。接下来是"重建"：他分析那堂糟糕的课，总结哪些做法有效、哪些无效，为将来吸取教训。最后是"换位"，也就是承认在人生的大格局中，一堂课真的无关紧要。

words: 与现实保持接触，不脱离实际
尽力把（不利的事）做好，充分利用
in the grand scheme of life

sections.title: Section IV Part A　应用文（合租邮件）
sections.dir: Suppose you are going to study abroad and share an apartment with John, a local student. Write him an email to 1) tell him about your living habits, and 2) ask for advice about living there. You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
sections.note: 两个要点缺一不可：先自报作息、卫生、饮食等习惯，再问当地生活建议（水电、购物、交通）。署名 Li Ming。
sections.sample:
Dear John,

I am writing to tell you a little about myself before we share the apartment. I am an early riser and usually go to bed before eleven, so I hope we can keep the flat quiet at night. I am fairly tidy and clean the kitchen once a week. I do not smoke or drink, but I enjoy cooking Chinese food at weekends and would be glad to cook for you.

Since this is my first time abroad, could you give me some advice? How much should I budget for utilities, and where is the nearest supermarket? Is there anything else I should know about the neighbourhood?

Looking forward to meeting you.

Yours,
Li Ming
tips: 开头一句点明写信目的（介绍自己的生活习惯），不要绕弯
习惯要具体：作息、卫生、饮食、是否吸烟，各一句就够，空话（I am easy-going）不加分
第二段必须落实题目第 2 点，问的是“当地生活”建议（水电、购物、周边），别写成学习建议

sections.title: Section IV Part B　图表作文
sections.dir: Write an essay based on the following chart. In your writing, you should 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments. You should write about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)
sections.sample:
The bar chart illustrates the changes in China's urban and rural population over the two decades from 1990 to 2010. In 1990, the urban population stood at 300 million, while 834 million people lived in the countryside. By 2000, the urban figure had risen to 458 million and the rural one had fallen to 807 million. A decade later the two had almost met, at 666 million and 674 million respectively.

Two features deserve attention. First, the urban population more than doubled in twenty years, growing by 366 million, whereas the rural population shrank by 160 million. Second, the gap between the two narrowed from 534 million to only 8 million, which means China is on the verge of becoming a predominantly urban society.

This shift is driven by industrialisation and by the better jobs, education and medical care that cities offer. It has brought prosperity, but it also puts pressure on housing, transport and the environment. Urbanisation is irreversible; what matters is that it be managed well.
tips: 第一段只读数：两组柱子、三个年份，按 1990→2000→2010 的顺序说清，别漏掉乡村那一组
第二段做对比：城镇翻倍（300→666）、乡村下降（834→674）、差距从 5.34 亿缩到 800 万，这三个数字最有说服力
第三段归因加评价，一句两面（繁荣 vs 住房、交通、环境压力），不要写成单边批判
